name: warm-editorial
summary: Warm cream editorial field with a soft beige vignette, near-black geometric type, deep-green hover cards and full-bleed sections, and a butter-yellow mascot/toggle halo that lives on objects, not on the field.
evidence: R7 t=6,9,11,22,33,34,100,110 bg: median of the lightest 30 % per frame = #F9F5F1/#F9F5F1/#F6F2EE/#F5F3EF/#F4EDE5/#F3ECE5/#F6F0EA/#F4EFE8, median #F6F1EC; frames with white doc cards (t=26,28) excluded
R7 t=36,38.5,120 full-bleed section = flat #003B31 (darkest 30 % and all four 20x20 corners identical); curtainColor measured on the wipe panel at t=35.7-35.8 corners (10,10)/(700,10) = #003B31

R7 t=6 'Rising freight costs' and t=26 'Managing in-house' and t=110 'Customer experience': darkest 25 % of ink = #000000, ink median #010000-#0F0700 (pure black cores; a crushed-black encode cannot be ruled out)
R7 t=6 '+$ 2.596' / '+$ 1.246' secondary labels: ink median #3D3834-#3F3A36 (2 px strokes at 414p, core likely darker); t=11 day labels Wed/Thu read lighter, #626B60 median

R7 t=37,38.5,45,110,120 mascot / logo-dot yellow (r>200,g>140,b<110 mask): medians #EFC92F/#F0CA33/#EFC92B/#F0C935/#F1CD2A -> accent #F0C92F; body is a vertical gradient #FADE60 (top 10 %) -> #E9BD0D (bottom 10 %)

R7 t=37 halo on green, 72-sample radial medians from mascot centre (369,229): r=78 #E1BE21, r=102 #8D9625, r=138 #48692B, r=192 #144A31, r=198 bg; alpha-blend fit of one colour over #003B31 -> #F0D21E, alpha 0.92 at the body edge, 0.50 at +42 px, 0.10 at +100 px, hard ring edge at r~195 px (0.47 H); stepped concentric bands, not a Gaussian

R7 t=33 knob halo on cream, radial medians from knob centre (425,205): r=72 #F1E6B0, r=96 #F2E9CB, r=132 #EEE4D5; fit over bg #F0EBE4 -> #FAD20A, alpha 0.235 at the knob edge, 0.11 at +36 px, 0.07 at +66 px (414p) -> pill glowAlpha 0.24, blur ~120 px at 1080; glow token #F5D21A = mean of both fits

R7 t=9,11,33,100,110 open cream field has no yellow chroma (lightest-30 % B within 8 levels of R); the yellow is only within ~200 px of the mascot/knob and moves with them (t=45 left, t=110 right, t=120 centre) -> field.glow 0, no explicit field glows, the halo is a surface/beat glow; only the green sections carry a field glow: t=50/45 (360,10) #5C8C3A vs base #003B31 = +79 luminance (0.31) top-centre, corners #004E40-#025E4C, bottom (360,400) #003028 -> a beat-level glow, see docs

R7 vignette: bg-only luminance (L>170, sat<60) by radial band centre->corner: t=33 242.9->211.2 (13 %), t=9 243.6->222.8 (8.5 %), t=11 242.9->220.6 (9 %), t=100 241.2->227.2 (6 %), t=110 235.4->219.0 (7 %) -> 0.10; the darkening is asymmetric (right edge darkest, a blurred warm photo)
R7 grain: high-pass (minus 2 px Gaussian) std on flat patches t=33 (40,320,100x60) 0.33 levels, t=34 0.30, t=22 0.18, t=36 green 0.00 -> 0.001, written as 0; no grid lines in the field

R7 t=13,14,15 green card: fill median #174C43 (top band #184D44, bottom #164B42 -> lift +0.005), 2 px solid pale-yellow hairline #FCF2CC (median of 10 edge samples) on all sides, corner radius 3-4 px of 371 px (0.01-0.015), no shadow (luminance 1-21 px below the card flat at 210.4-211.7, right side flat 235.6)
